collection.title: Fiat 500 500 C 2009 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Fiat 500 C 2009 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Fiat 500 500 C 2009 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
